steps.label: Why hybrid programs need split profiling categories

steps.label: Why queue wait dwarfs almost everything else
steps.sub: On real hardware, and how to profile around that

code:
def run_vqe_iteration(params,
    backend, acc):
  t0 = time.perf_counter()
  circuit = bind_params(params)
  t1 = time.perf_counter()
  counts = backend.run(circuit,
    shots=1024)
  t2 = time.perf_counter()
  expectation = compute_expectation(
    counts)
  t3 = time.perf_counter()
  acc.classical_time += (t1-t0)+(t3-t2)
  acc.quantum_time += (t2-t1)
caption: This small amount of instrumentation answers the question that matters: what fraction of total time is actually the quantum part?
